reviews.comment: Best professor ever. Anyone giving Prof. Allen less than 5 stars is either insane or just beyond help. Such a patient and kind person that will go above and beyond to help you succeed. Business calc is tough but she makes it so manageable. I could actually go on forever about what a phenomenal teacher this is, DO ANYTHING YOU CAN TO TAKE HER!!!!
So sweet and cares about our understanding of material.

Professor Allen is the queen of calculus and the best professor I've ever had. Calculus is hard but she breaks it down so well and her patience is absolutely unmatched. Even bad questions she handles well and answers thoroughly. She's genuinely the best possible professor that you could have for this class and I'm extremely grateful to have her.
BEST professor of all time if you're taking 142 or 140 make sure you take her.Only issue is she doesn't have the best taste in gatorades but she's working on that.

She's an amazing teacher- if I could have her teach all my classes, I would. This is the only math class I've ever enjoyed because she cares about her students. Only tests what we are learning, and not anything else. First time taking Calc, and I am thinking about taking another math just because she teaches it so well. 100/10.

This class is so GOOD. Professor Allen explains concepts really well, and her tests and quizzes are not too hard. She is also just so nice; she learns all of her students' names, and she is always willing to help!

my favorite prof!! so many people i know struggled in math 140 but she made it so easy, shes an amazing teacher. weekly homework but multiple attempts so you should always get a 100. shes very responsive and encourages people to ask questions, then thoroughly answers and explains. we did have a lot of work (class and video quizzes) but it is easy

Her lectures were good and I felt like I knew the material very well and was really prepared for exams, then I got in there and the tests were nothing like the material she gives us. The wording was different and just the whole format was off. good teacher, hard exams.

Professor Allen was amazing. While I already had a lot of background knowledge on most of the concepts learned in Math 140, she explained everything extremely well, almost like she was explaining to a little kid. She simplified everything and encouraged questions and answered them until the concepts were clear. I couldn't recommend her enough!

Professor Allen is wonderful. She is very easy to reach outside of class if you are struggling or just have questions. If you take MATH140 with prior calculus/pre-calculus knowledge you might find this class boring. There is homework every week and quizzes every other week, and she ends up dropping the lowest grades.

Professor Allen was a great professor! I'm definitely not a math person and was nervous coming in to take math 140, but she explains everything and does the best to make you succeed! I was able to get an A in the class and get A's on almost every test! 100% take Professor Allen!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This is the goat. Take her.
Dr. Allen was a great professor who really cared about her students!

This is the math professor you want. End of discussion. Dr. Allen is the sweetest professor and tries to make the concepts as easy and understandable for us as she can. She will stop lecture for any questions and fight the math department to get us easier tests and quizzes. You will not find a more reasonable and lovely human than Dr. Allen.

She is such a amazing professor and genuinely wants her students to pass. There are weekly in class quizzes (2 get dropped). She tells you gonna be on quizzes and exams. If you have taken calc in high school. you'll be fine just focus on the linear programming and finance chapters. I recommend HOGU and WIR if you need the extra practice.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Allen is very good at teaching when it comes to math. She goes through all the problems and concepts in the notes during lectures step by step and answers all questions. Exams are a bit difficult but she explains how to study.

As someone who is completely horrible at math, Allen is great. Yes, I still suck at math, but she is incredibly caring and patient when it comes to teaching. Homework are easy, you get 6 tries per question. There are weekly quizzes but they are occasionally taken with a group. Start studying early for tests if you dont understand. Lovely lady.

TAKE HER!!!! I am so bad at math but she was so kind, never demeaning, and always was willing to take the time to help her students really understand. The course sucks- cumulative final, weekly homeworks, in class iclicker + individual/group quizzes, videos to watch before class. Drops 2 of each assignment and tells what concepts will be on tests.
Love her so much!! She truly desires to help her students in every way and genuinely wants everyone to understand the material. She's a great prof

Overall an easy class and a nice lady. The TA Andy would go around and ask people to put their phones away during lecture which made me feel like I was still in high school. Like buddy you're assisting one of the easiest classes in the university lil bro you aint tough. But other than that nothing but good things to say about her and the class.

She's one of a kind. I've never had a better math teacher. The only thing I didn't like about her class was her policy on technology but it's understandable. She's very kind, sweet, and incredibly knowledgeable. Probably the only teacher I've ever felt comfortable going to help hours for.

Angela Allen is a good, caring teacher. Overall, the class is easy. You should get 100s on the homework, and if you sufficiently study, you can do great on the quizzes and tests. I found the class a little boring since it's similar to what you learn in high school (e.g., algebra, basic statistics, etc.) Despite that, I recommend Allen for Math 140.

The sweetest soul ever. I loved being in Dr. Allen's class so much. I am a professional math hater, but Dr. Allen kept me going. She tries really hard to set her students up for success and treats me like her own kid. If you happen to get her for Math 140, just know you are in good hands! I'd also recommend to go to office hours!

(MATH365 is basically MATH135 which is what I had her for)
Prof Allen is amazing! She gives very helpful reviews before exams/quizzes, not a lot of homework. She is very understanding and sweet. If you want an A go to at least 90% of the lectures (I skipped a few and still did well). Best prof I've had so far, she is really good at her job

I LOVE PROF ALLEN! I would take all the math courses available at TAMU if Professor Allen taught all of them. She is awesome. Attendance was counted randomly through iClicker, but all Math 140 courses require that. She really wants you to succeed in the course and you can tell she loves to teach. She is funny, caring, and engaging.

Professor Allen is the kind of professor everyone hopes for in college. She truly cares that you understand the material and encourages questions. Her teaching style is fast-paced, but she'll gladly slow down if needed. Her explanations are clear, engaging, and incredibly helpful.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I was so scared for math 140 BUT take it with prof allen!! She explains the concepts well. Not to mention she is so caring . I missed a week of classes and she was the most understanding prof I had come across. There is weekly homework and quizzes but honestly if you go to class and do your homework you will def pass the class.

Professor Allen is such a sweetheart and it's not her fault that I hate calculus. She made it as easy for us as she possibly could- do the homework and the video quizzes. If I hadn't slept through her class I probably could've made an A.

Mrs. Allen cares a lot for those who have never taken calculus before. She explains topics in depth and always waits for questions so she can answer them. Although if you have taken calc before, get ready to learn things a whole different way. Some methods she teaches are different than what you learned in AP calc. She wants her way on exams.

Professor Allen was incredible at teaching MATH 142 and explained everything she wanted you to know and show in steps. Throughout the semester, she noted what to write down on flashcards for the final. For every exam, she created a concept guide and linked her week-in-reviews. Video quizzes and WebAssign every week, but she dropped two of each.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Best math teacher I have ever had. I wish I could take the rest of my classes with her. Material was difficult but she offered so much outside help that you should take advantage of.

I feel so blessed to have had Prof Allen for Math 142. It is a difficult course, but she is very knowledgeable and was always there for me whenever I needed help. Definitely recommend going to her office hours as her TA's are also very helpful. Make sure to rework your notes and do her exam reviews and you will do well. You want to take her class!!

She will probably be one of my favorite college professors. Her class was so hard, but she stuck with me the whole time and helped me learn how to learn better. I always knew that I could go to her after class or in office hours and she would help me figure out what I was doing wrong. This class is a lot of work but Prof Allen makes it worth it!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was so funny and so caring! Calculus is hard to understand and she walked us through it incredibly well! She also dropped two of our lowest quiz and homework grades. The first exam was very hard but it seemingly has gotten better, tests weigh a lot but she really wanted us to do well in her class! Very easy to talk to!

Prof. Allen is a dedicated instructor who truly wants her students to succeed. While the course can be challenging, her clear explanations and helpful office hours make it manageable. unstuckstudy was a great study aid alongside the textbook.

This professor was the best math instructor I have ever had. She explains complicated concepts so well and makes her TAs go up and down the aisles during lecture to help answer questions. Very caring, approachable, and understanding. Structures her notes and Canvas page in an intuitive fashion that makes it easy to understand what's going on.

Prof. Allen is one of the best professors at A&M!! She truly cares about her students and wants them to do well. She teaches hard topics very well! Attendance not mandatory, however, usually iclicker for most classes that are used for attendance, but not always. Weekly hw's that usually take some time but given plenty of time to do them.

Professor Allen is the best math professor at Texas A&M University. Math 142 is a difficult class, but she teaches the material so that everyone can understand. She goes above and beyond to help her students succeed. I had some health issues during the semester, and she was super understanding. Could not recommend her enough. Amazing person.

I loved Prof Allen! She truly cares about her students and wants them to do well. I recommend going to office hours to work on homework. Prof Allen gives weekly in class quizzes where you have 15 mins to finish. The homeworks take a few hours, but she really wants to help so that her students do well on exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Allen is the best professor I have ever had at A&M. I had never taken calculus in my life and she made it easy to understand. Her notes are very straightforward and are filled with examples of the things we will see on the exams. The exams were difficult but very doable. If you attend office hours and get help you will succeed in this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very good lecturer and explains the material very well. She is very nice and easily accessible outside of class. The class itself isn't the easiest but the amount of practice and explination she gives makes it ver difficult.

Professor Allen is very knowledgable but she teaches really fast (there's a lot of material to cover). She has a lot of office hours and is always willing to help. She is a pretty good teacher the class is just time consuming.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A lot of the learning we had to do ourselves via videos but she covered the material properly as well as provide examples to help further understanding. Lots of homework and quizzes but nothing not manageable. Very fast paced class which was a bit of a problem, but she does have great feedback on quizzes and tests which helps review for future use.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are hard but provides you with plenty of material to study. Units are hard only because you have to solve problems with specific notation regardless if you've previously taken calculus and learned a different way. She tells us exactly what to know for the exams by writing out a checklist. Rework your notes until you can do them first try.

Professor Allen is such a sweet lady, but she is the head of the math department and wrote the textbook. Because of this, she tends to teach the concepts in her own way instead of the standard way. All of your quizzes will be in class and on your own. You need to go to class cause she hints about what's on the exam. Hard class, but she helps a lot!
She was extremely accommodating and helpful at every step of the semester. I would gladly take her again and her attention to detail when teaching was great.

I'm not a big fan of math, but she's one of the only professors whose lectures I enjoy. She genuinely cares about  students' grades, and she's incredibly kind and funny. It may be a strict curriculum, but she makes the workload easier to understand and less overwhelming.
She is the best math teacher I have ever had, would definitely recommend.
Best Professor I have ever had. Cares about your grade and lectures are fun. While I love math, she makes it even better. I hope everyone has the chance to take this course.
Amazing professor. She really knows how to teach the material. Material was very hard but her week in reviews are very helpful. Had her for math 142 also and she's the best prof i've had.

Prof Allen has my been favorite professor so far! For someone who's not great at math, the way she lectures was so helpful. Also, attending her week in reviews really helped with homework and studying for exams. She gives extra points with iclicker and drops the 2 lowest quiz and homework grades. She also quickly responds to emails. Take her!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I did not take this prof, but attended all the WIR she holds. I wish I would have taken her. She does a great job at explaining and breaking down the problems. I know a lot of people that were not in her class but would go to her class in addition to their because of how she teaches.

Be prepared for lots of work (5-8 assignments/week). Felt like I was always doing work for this class. Otherwise, she was a good prof. Dropped lots of grades at the end and boosted my grade 4 points. Go to WIR and study and you'll be fine. Final exam grade replaces your lowest test score. Participation iClicker sometimes. Take her.

I am not a math person. Allen understands this and teaches in a way that makes sense. she cares for her students and advocates for them within her department, and even got approval to drop a second quiz grade

Don't regret taking Ms.Allen. Best professor I've had yet in A&M. She is very caring and understanding for the students. If you pay attention in every lecture and do every assignment on time, without a doubt you'll get a A+. She teaches AMAZING!!!

Math 140 is HARD period. Allen is about the best you're gonna get. Class structure: 2-3 online homeworks (5-15 questions) WEEKLY, 1 IN CLASS paper quiz WEEKLY, 2-3 quiz/videos on canvas WEEKLY, exams every 2-4 weeks. The most work I've had for a class at A&M yet.  Allen did her best to explain and help prepare for exams. (More than other profs)

Best professor in the math department! I had professor Allen for Math 140 and 142 and she is the BEST! If you go to lecture and do the homework you will be set. 140 is a tough class but she always has great TAs and is super open to help at anytime. I could recommend her enough!

TAKE ANGELA ALLEN! She is the nicest and most caring teacher. The first 2 exams cover easy material, and the 3rd test is more pre-cal based. Overall, this class was pretty light, and there was almost no homework for the class. She is definitely the best math professor you could get at A&M. She made Math 140 easily digestible.

Probably one of the best math profs/teachers I've ever had, definitely the best math 140 prof at A&M. She is so caring and so eager to help. She writes her own test that are very very accurate if not easier than how she teaches in class. Truly such a sweet lady, I was very lucky to have gotten into her class. Have not heard of a better 140 prof!

Dr. Allen was a wonderful prof, considering that it's a math class. She clearly explains all the material, but the homework is a bit harder than the lecture. You definitely need to study for quizzes and exams, but practice exams and week-in-reviews are super helpful! Overall, Dr. Allen was a good, friendly, and understanding professor.

This class is hard, but tutoring is what got me through studying and homework. Each lecture handles A LOT of material so it can be overwhelming. Every Thursday you have an open ended quiz and you have 2-3 assignments due a week. I think this class is hard for a lot of people, but it is doable. Definitely spent most my time on this class.
Very difficult class. I struggled to pass and the lectures felt very rushed.

This class was super hard. I felt like I went above and beyond when it came to studying and doing work but I still failed. It was super hard to get good help from the school and she was never available. All the reviews are from other classes.This class gpa was one of the lowest with this prof. Most people goals was a D very hard. Many ppl dropped.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's an amazing teacher who tries to clear up any misunderstandings as she's teaching. She also takes time at the end of lectures to answer any questions you may have. There's a module that tells you what days the clicker questions will happen and summarize what needs to be done. There are plenty of office hours with the TAs too.

Professor Allen is awesome! You can tell she cares a lot about her students and explains everything in a way that is super easy to understand. If you go to class you will do great. She gives clear outlines of what will be on exams and prepares you well. Weekly quizzes and homework that have similar questions to the exams. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Allen is an amazing professor who goes above and beyond for her students. Lectures are necessary to pass the class, and if you go to her office hours you may be able to gain points back on your quizzes. In general, office hours are amazing- extremely fun and helpful. She's very understanding as long as you put in work on your end.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Allen is amazing and wants to help her students. The homework and weekly quizzes can be a lot, but that is a departmental requirement. Despite the department's rules, she tries to make her class as easy as possible. The tests are harder than in-class examples, but she provides a good foundation to approach more difficult questions.

Professor Allen is a SUPER nice and genuine lady. She made going to class enjoyable. If you have any questions about the homework GO TO OFFICE HOURS. They actually help a lot. The homework and tests are fairly easy. Also, note that Math 140 is a departmentalized course meaning that the department creates the grading criteria, not professor Allen.

shes honestly awesome, class examples are too easy compared to homework, but not her fault. very accommodating and flexible, very kind and caring. the way shes required to grade things makes the class difficult, but again, not her fault, highly recommend.

She seems very nice at the beginning due to her tone with the class. But she only does the easiest of examples in class, not to mention random clicker quizzes. Tons of homework every week with a quiz due as well. Tests are very complex and hard, nothing like lectures or homework. Requires a lot of studying to pass.

Angela Allen seems like an amazing teacher right off the bat because her tone with the class and her interactions are super kind. However, she does the easiest examples in class and the homework is nothing like what is taught in class. Quizzes every week, 4 HARD tests, multiple hours of homework a week. I will say she is very helpful when you ask.

Allen is so fun and enthusiastic and she really wants you to learn. The class can be difficult so you have to study a lot before tests, it is not like math 140. Do the Homeworks and video quizzes because they give a lot of practice and she does not go over the videos in class.

Best professor at A&M for math by far! She's caring, funny, and tries to make relationships with her students. She's very helpful, great at explaining content, and answers any questions you may have. However, she strictly follows the department guidelines. This is a challenging class, but she makes it bearable. Take her if you have the chance!

Allen is the best professor I have had at A&M so far and the best math teacher. She is caring and accepts any question with a great attitude. She genuinely wants all students to succeed. THE BEST teacher for 142. Take her! 3 exams, a comprehensive final, and two sections of HW and a quiz every week. Clickers are participation only.

Professor Allen was super nice and really good at explaining topics. She gave lots of assignments throughout the semester so that she could drop as much as she could from the final grade. I highly recommend taking Professor Allen for Math 142!

Prof Allen is definitely the way to go if you need to take 142 at A&M. She is so caring and wants everyone to succeed. Her TAs are awesome and office hours rlly help. You have to put in the work, though. She gives you everything you need to succeed and then some. Take her!!!

If you need any math credits, I HIGHLY suggest you take Allen if possible! She is the most caring professor I have had here at TAMU and made calculus so much easier. She s funny and makes lectures very interesting and engaging. I had 0 exposure to calculus prior to taking this class, and Id say I got a really good grasp of it thanks to her!!

Office hours are super helpful but so many people go it's hard to get one on one attention. TA's were pretty helpful. Concept questions on the test always got me but they are directly from the notes so just study a lot. Tests are nothing like the homework. Tried to make lecture fun and gave breaks with iclicker so make sure you go to class!!!!!

Probably my favorite professor at A&M so far. She takes the time to go over things if students don't understand and doesn't make anyone feel rushed. She definitely cares about her students and is super sweet and funny. Lots of easy extra credit. Hard class but she makes it feel a lot more doable!! Lots of opportunities to raise/replace grades.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really liked this professor. I think my problem is the course is just really difficult and you have 8-10+ differing assignments due each week. It makes it feel like your endless working on this class (math 142). having assignments due Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday;

Best professor on campus! The main issue with this course is the Math Department, not this gem of a professor. Study and attend all the help sessions you can, Dr. Allen cares about her students' success and will be there to happily help. Note the final unfortunately has heavy weight on your grade. Oh, def ask her about Ms. Rev barking in her class!

Prof Allen was amazing. I have never taken calculus before and she was so patient and great at explaining things. She was head of the Week In Reviews and those mimicked exams very closely. Homework also prepared you for exams. DEFINITELY take her.

reviews.comment: made an A somehow at the very end. Go to class, study, do week in review.

reviews.comment: ABSOLUTELY LOVE prof Allen!! She is super caring and knows almost all of her students by name. Go to her office hours every week! You can build a great relationship with her there (and other students too). She's super knowledgeable and organized. Do the week in reviews for the exams and you're golden.

Allen is a sweet understanding prof. HOWEVER she follows the Departments ruled VERBATIM. She isnt allowed to give much extra credit because the department etc etc. But in the bright side she truly is a good teacher so you need to rely on truly learning. 10/10 for Allen. .05/10 for the MaTh dEpArTmEnT. oh she takes aggie honor code serious
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Allen was my absolute FAVORITE professor! She is so kind, caring and really wants her students to succeed. She explains the topics very well, and uses steps to help guide each problem. She is very organized and knows what she's doing. Show up to class, take notes, ask questions, and do her week-in-reviews! And you will get an A!!
She is an amazing and kind professor but her class was the hardest class I ever had to take. Granted, I am not very good at math, so if math is your strong suite, take her.
Professor Allen is one of, if not, the best professors I have had at TAMU. If you have the opportunity to take her class definitely take it! Attending office hours helped me tremendously.

Best professor ever. She actually cares about her students. You will make an A if you attend class, take notes, and study for exams. There are no secrets to her class. Just take care of your work and she'll take care of you. 10/10 recommend professor Allen.

Be sure to review notes and old hw assignments for tests. She is the best professor I have ever had and really cares about her students. I started off with an ok grade at the beginning of the semester. I started going to office hours regularly and my grade improved tremendously.  If you are able to take a class taught by her do it!!!!
She's the best professor I've ever had. She genuinely wants you to do well and will do anything to help you.

One of the best professors I've had here, especially for math. Explains difficult concepts very clearly, truly wants you to learn and succeed. Grade made up of 3 exams, a final, weekly-ish quizzes, and online homework. Gave lots of extra credit opportunities. Take her!!!

I previously took 142 with another prof and had to Q-drop, but ended up making an A with Dr. Allen. Materials can be challenging, but she gives lots of extra credits and wants you to succeed! Final is cumulative and replaces your lowest test. She also drops your lowest HW and quiz. Go to class, do HW, rework notes, and study! She's a gem! TAKE HER!

reviews.comment: Im not the best at math but this class was extremely hard. I was constantly in office hours and going to study sessions and I still did not make good grades.

Participation does matter bc she doesn't post the notes and study for the tests since they're the biggest part of your grade!

reviews.comment: Professor Allen is one of the sweetest profs I've ever had! I had never taken a calc class before this one, but she made the material easy to understand and gave a lot of practice to work through. She does give a lot of homework and there are pop-quizzes in class, but they all prepare you for her tests and are easy if you understand the notes.

Allen was easily one of my fav prof. She was always available during office hours & she really cares for her students. Calc is difficult, but she makes it easy to understand & even if you don't going to her office hours help. An A is very attainable. I would say that working on hw, notes, & WIR help when studying for the exams.

All I have to say: WOW. Dr. Allen is AMAZING!!! I am 100% not a math person at all. Not only is she so caring and kind, but she makes learning math simple!! Ive never met such a wonderful professor. She really cares about her students as people and makes sure everyone is succeeding in and out of the classroom. Best math professor EVER hands down.

Dr. Allen is a great professor. I took calc AB in high school but it had been a two years since I took so I was worried. She taught the topics super well and clear. Easily able to understand, homework due every week and quiz every week. She drops some homework and quizzes too. We moved online because of the ronie so the final was optional.
Great prof! great at explaining the material!

reviews.comment: I took her class fall 2019 and loved it. She gives good reviews to ensure that you are prepared for each exam. Quiz every week but some are dropped. Extra credit opportunities on almost every test. She was able to call on everyone by name in my 90 person class. She cares a lot about each student succeeding in her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: If you aren't good at math, but are willing to work for a good grade - take this class!!! Her office hours are one of the best resources offered and can even become a way to keep yourself accountable and on top of the material all semester. Literally rework your notes a few times and the tests are a breeze, there's honestly no need for tutoring.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Allen is by far the best Math142 prof. She truly cares. Starting fall19 she is teaching a 90 person class instead of her usual 300 person class due to grant work. I highly recommend her, she knew most people's name and supported everyone. She has reviews for every exam and lays out each Q. EC on 3/4 exams. Partial credit on workout problems!

Never had problems with math before, but I have never enjoyed it like I have enjoyed her class. She is amazing and her tests are incredibly easy in comparison to other professors that I have taken. As long as you understand the basics of what she is teaching, you are guaranteed an A. Not to mention that she is the sweetest professor that I have had

I have never rated a professor before, but I feel the need to for Professor Allen. She makes calculus so easy to understand, and makes math fun. She is very willing to help and really wants to see her students succeed. Just be prepared for the weekly quizzes because they can either really help you or hurt you, but they are nothing hard. TAKE HER!

reviews.comment: i had never taken calculus so i was a little worried, im not the best at math, but i went to all of her office hours, and she will really help you walk through things and make sure you understand a topic. you should take diligent notes, she will use examples from notes on test so make sure you know it.

I was really nervous about this class because I had never taken calculus before. Professor Allen explained concepts very clearly and really seemed to care about her students. reviews.comment: Calculus is hard. The subject cant be eAsy if youre not mathematically gifted but Professor Allen makes it doable. She will do anything to help you understand. Take her!

She said the final would be all "work-out" type problems but there was still a lot of concept so that sucked but she gives lot of extra credit and I honestly learned more from her than I did in hs calc.

Professor Allen, is probably the best person to take MATH 142 with. Her tests are at least 75% conceptual, so please know how to work everyone problem from start to answer, detailing how everything fits into that problem. Definitely not a blow off class, but if you like hands on respectful professors who actually help, take her. She is awesome.

Most difficult thing about the class is that the tests don't include much math and are more focused around concepts. Homework is truly easy but nothing close to the level on the tests. Would not recommend this professor if you are expecting to legitimately do math. Going to lectures provides notes, but the notes won't help prepare you for tests.

The material is difficult but she is an amazing prof who is always there for you if you need help! Her week-in-reviews are the best ways to prepare for the exams. There is a lot of homework but try to get good grades on them because they will help your grade in the class. She is probably the best professor to take Math 142 from at Texas A&M.

Dr. Allen is such a nice professor, but she is tough! Her tests are mostly "concepts" rather than math. She is always there to help you with any questions you may have. She gives extra information about what is on the test at office hours. Do the week in Reviews! She pulls some test questions straight from those. She offers some bonus on exams.
She is awesome! By far the best math professor I've had at A&M! Go to her office hours, she is very helpful. She will help you with homework, and give you advice about the tests.

Prof Allen was a great professor! Although the class is very difficult and a majority of the students failed the first test, Prof Allen gave us extra credit on every test and final. I got a 52 on the first test and was able to finish with an A by the end of the semester. WORK HER WEEK-IN REVIEWS. Majority of test questions come straight from them.

Allen is a wonderful teacher who will stop to help if you do not understand something or have questions. The test are tough and I recommend you do every week in review to prepare for them. She does give a generous curve on the test when students don't do well. I bombed my final and 23 test and somehow managed to get a B in her class!! Take Allen!!

Allen was the best professor I've ever had by far! Uses web assign for homework (drops 4 lowest), weekly quizzes (drops one), 3 tests (usually curves), one cumulative final. I'll most likely fail calculus, but that's because I'm horrid at math. She has the most incredible passion for students DO WHATEVER YOU CAN TO TAKE Allen!

This is a tough course. However, professor is AMAZING and she helps you as much as she possibly can. It's a tough course  but if you put in the work and she's sees that she is more than willing to help. I would recommend her any day. LOVE her! (oh yea sit at the front and talk to her in the beginning of class)

She can go through the notes pretty quickly, but she'll stop and explain something if you ask. She's a really sweet person and keeps it interesting. Her tests are different from the homework and the quizzes though. Study!!

Allen has been my favorite professor this semester! The material isn't easy but she cares about her students and will do what she can to help you pass! Look at the week-in-reviews and you're golden for the tests!

This class was super difficult. However, Angela Allen has been one of the most helpful math teacher I have ever had. You definitely have to study for the test but as long as you do the week in reviews over and over and go to her office hours she will be willing to help you as much as possible.

Prof Allen is amazing. You can ask her any question in class. She loves to clarify anything you have questions on. She is easy to talk to, very laid back, and she wants nothing more than for her students to succeed. Get to know her, go to her office hours, she will help you as much as you need. I would recommend her 110%!!
Best teacher I have ever had at A&M. If you have to take 131 or 142 take her class. She is super helpful and attentive. It is not an easy class though, so just be prepared to actually do work.

Professor Allen is by far the best professor I've had at A&M. She is SOOO willing to help you and takes time to remember names if you make an effort to go to her. The workload isn't bad at all & she really prepares you for the tests so that they're a walk through the park. She is BY FAR the best calculus professor here. & she's super nice. Take her

Professor Allen is by far the best professor I've had at A&M. She is SOOO willing to help you and takes time to remember names if you make an effort to go to her. The workload isn't bad at all & she really prepares you for the tests so that they're a walk through the park. She is BY FAR the best calculus professor here. & she's super nice!

Allen was a great professor, however her exams are extremely difficult. She curved every exam and the final grade. Although despite that I ended up failing. Go to her WIR sessions and office hours and do all the homework assignments and you should be able to pass. The exams were multiple choice and the other profs are work out questions.

Extremely difficult class. Professor Allen is unclear and has very high expectations. Many students have to Q-Drop (she had a 60% Q-Drop rate Spring 2013). I got outside tutoring and spent over 14 hours a week on this class and still got a B. DON'T TAKE ANGELA ALLEN!!!
Dr. Allen is wonderful. She is young, and very kind. She truly wants her students to succeed, and will do everything she can to help. She also curves the test (a lot). TAKE HER!

This woman is possibly the sweetest woman you will ever meet in your life. I can't help but feel she is so adorable, and you can tell she genuinely cares about her students. Her exams can be kind of rough, mainly because of conceptual stuff, but she's more than willing to help! Not to mention she's not bad to look at either.

Easily the best prof I've ever had. She's super helpful, and teaches well. I had dropped this class 2 times prior to taking it with her, and she was a lifesaver. Go to the week in review and an A isn't out of the question.

She is great. I am not a math person and I made an A. Go to the week in reviews and do all your homework. She makes everything make sense. She even dropped 4 hw grades and replaced the lowest test grade with the final if it helped.

Allen is an awesome professor. She fills the notes in with you and takes questions and everything. Shes not foreign, jokes around, and her tests aren't impossible. Just go to her week-in reviews or at least look over the answer key for tests.

She is a GREAT professor. Extremely nice, approachable, and is always willing to help. This class is very difficult, but she makes the material much more clear and easy to understand. Highly recommend her.

Mrs. Allen is a great professor. It's refreshing to get a prof who really wants to see their students succeed and gives them every opportunity to do so. Even though attendance is not mandatory, you need to go for the notes and clicker quizzes.
Ms. Allen is the best. So nice and so funny. Class is tough but definitely possible especially with such a great teacher!
I would ABSOLUTELY recommend Allen. I am by NO means a math person, but she made the class enjoyable and understandable. She's sweet as can be, and it's a joy being taught by her.

I would absolutely recommend Ms. Allen to anyone, and would take another class from her in a heartbeat!!!  She really goes out of her way for students, and thoroughly enjoys teaching math.  It's clear that she loves helping students, and loves her job.  This class is incredibly rough, but I love Ms. Allen!

She is one of the greatest lecturer I have ever seen. Although the class is not easy, you can still get an A if you study and go to her office hour. She is really nice and hot. One thing I like about her is that she really cares about you. She will try the best to help you if you ask for help.
Awesome Prof... really great

Mrs. Allen is the best math teacher you will ever have.  Period.  She's beautiful, friendly, extremely smart, and made this subject (which is basically a weed out course) one that I enjoyed going to.  She will stop at nothing to help you.  She learns everyone's names, and she explained the subject unbelievably clear.  Take Mrs. Allen.  Bottom Line.

She is awesome, I loved her class and her.  She is the best professor so far at A&M, if you have to take this class, do take it with her, you won't regret it, she is so nice that makes everything easy for the whole class.  You take quizzes, which are straight out of from the homework, and tests are not hard at all compared to other professors.
She is really helpful. If you ever need anything or have any questions she is there to help.  As long as you go to class and take notes you should be fine.

she is a great prof. She is very helpful if you have any questions -- definately approachable. You will do fine on the tests as long as you go to class for the examples in your notes and do the suggested homework problems.
Shes an awesome Prof, and she's young so she can relate to us as students
